native_voice.afe_fix: mtk_afe_pcm_pointer checks the DAI id before indexing memory interfaces; Hostless_Speech id 12 has no memif
native_voice.guard_cases: Valid ids preserve the hardware pointer; negative, first out-of-range, Hostless_Speech and INT_MAX ids avoid array/register access
native_voice.existing_route: Hostless_Speech connects ADDA to PCM2/MD1; PCM2 uses mode B and asynchronous FIFO
native_voice.remaining: Establish the modem speech-control contract and an owner that prepares and holds the duplex hostless PCM route for the call lifetime; then integrate the standard ALSA VoiceCall profile used by callaudiod
native_voice.public_vendor_contract: GPL CCCI maps PCM RX/TX channels 4/5 to ccci_aud with user headers. Its kernel port neither decodes speech messages nor supplies a startup acknowledgement; missing channel handling alone does not establish the modem-watchdog cause.

limitations.native_transport_and_sim: Trial 95 reaches HS2 READY, then the modem watchdog fires before SIM diagnostics. ModemManager's SIM-missing fallback does not establish physical card absence.

esim.status: Native modem/eUICC access and GUI integration incomplete
esim.public_board_contract: Planet Gemini user guide identifies physical SIM as slot 1 and eSIM as slot 2.
esim.architecture: Native CCCI exposes standard Linux WWAN AT ports. A generic GUI AT backend should reuse lpac standard APDU commands and ModemManager port/slot metadata with exclusive inhibition ownership; CCCI framing remains a kernel responsibility.
remaining: Select a declarative named SIM state inside the protected cold transaction; the observed inherited electrical state matches the public board configuration but Linux has not claimed its pads.
Resolve the native modem watchdog and establish eUICC APDU routing; standard AT availability alone does not establish SIM presence or a selected physical slot.
Integrate the checked lpac transport repair and complete operation/session cancellation, deadline and long-response behavior before provisioning.

Finish generic GUI AT discovery and operations through standard ModemManager/WWAN interfaces. Generic AT ModemManager lacks EID/type loaders, so empty-eUICC discovery needs standard chip-info; do not guess slot2.
esim.board_observation: Accepted115 finite two-snapshot read passes identity/taint/native-node guards and confirms unchanged inherited six-pad numeric encoding. Both locks released and host idle; no pin selection, AT command or subscriber query. The earlier113 parser failure remains historical.

lpac_transport_candidate.scope: Complete short writes, handle EINTR and terminate on closed/failed AT transport; preserve fragmented and readable final responses. No silent-operation deadline, slot or provision qualification.

native_at_terminal.status: Installed fatal withdrawal qualified through standard WWAN HUP/ERR and port removal
native_at_terminal.scope: Standard WWAN removal wakes blocked RX/TX and exposes HUP/ERR; native RX/pointer lifetime and terminal work cancellation serialized. Original DMA STOP/retention contract unchanged.

native_sim_electrical_maps.status: Installed native maps and inherited six-pad electrical encoding observed; declarative cold-owner state pending
native_sim_electrical_maps.scope: IES, SMT, PUPD, R0 and R1 maps and pull type only; no state selection or guessed pull strength
native_sim_electrical_maps.inherited_state: All six mode1/IES1/SMT1; CLK/RST output-direction and pulls disabled, SIO input-direction and pull-up R1/R0=1/0(code102); all unclaimed

native_modem_runtime.status: Installed bounded public DBM initializer; modem watchdog persists
native_modem_runtime.scope: Initialize only the 56-byte disabled-PBM region before the validated HS1 runtime response; retain the existing barrier and DMA STOP ownership
